{"code": "from scipy import stats

# Perform a one-sample t-test against zero
t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_1samp(trial_df['biomarker_change'], 0)

# Print results
print(f"One-sample t-test against zero:")
print(f"- t-statistic: {t_stat:.4f}")
print(f"- p-value: {p_val:.6f}")

# Check if the median is significantly different from zero using Wilcoxon signed-rank test
wilcoxon_stat, wilcoxon_p = stats.wilcoxon(trial_df['biomarker_change'] - 0)

print(f"\nWilcoxon signed-rank test (median vs zero):")
print(f"- Test statistic: {wilcoxon_stat:.0f}")
print(f"- p-value: {wilcoxon_p:.6f}")"}
